+title: 'maxTurns: the counting decorator and hitMaxTurns'
+---
+## What
+Plan.md §5 (`maxTurns`), §9.3 (`maxTurns` counts the task turn and each child-delivery turn). M6 semantics.
+
+- Create `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Tools/TurnCountingTool.swift`: a decorator `Tool` that wraps each resolved tool and adds one to a shared per-run counter on each tool call.
+- The run adds one to the same counter for the task turn and for each delivery turn (`dispatchNextPrompt`).
+- When the count goes above `maxTurns`, the run cancels its turn and fails with `AgentRunFailure.hitMaxTurns(partial: String)`, with the partial text of the turn. Open children are cancelled first (the nested-run rule).
+- No `maxTurns` key: no limit.
+- The failed run posts one `.completed` with the failure text.
+- Write the exact counting rule in the doc comment of the decorator.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `maxTurns: 2` with a script of three tool calls fails with `hitMaxTurns` and the partial text.
+- [ ] `maxTurns: 3` with a task turn and two delivery turns and no tool calls succeeds; with a third delivery turn it fails.
+- [ ] A run with no `maxTurns` and many tool calls succeeds.
+- [ ] A `hitMaxTurns` run with an open child cancels the child first.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsAgentsTests/MaxTurnsTests.swift` covers each criterion.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter MaxTurnsTests`. Expected: pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
